authority: Root explicitly accepted this low-cost investment screen and requested freeze; no new GPU authorization requested or implied.

source_versions.exact_source_revision_and_model_manifest: Must be included and hash-bound in IC_EXPORT_RECEIPT; no unverified hardcoded current revision.

allowed: hashed question identifiers and paired execution seeds
information_permissions.release: R1 actions already immutable; export receipt binds protocol, action freeze, model/source manifests and NPZ hash.

estimators.source: mean I_A_gain over all 12 independent I questions
estimators.drift: B_gain - A_gain on identical C question/seed
estimators.transport: source + mean first 3 training rows of drift
estimators.direct: mean first 5 training rows of B_gain
estimators.general_cv: mean first 3 B_gain - beta*(mean first 3 A_gain - source)
estimators.no_bank_cold_direct: Same direct action, separate cost accounting; never replaces the primary baseline.
estimators.editor: max gain strictly greater than 0; exact ties choose smallest physical edge; else stay

risk_estimation.v_A: I_A_gain sample variance over 12 I rows, ddof=1, per episode/edge
risk_estimation.v_B: B_gain sample variance over all 12 C rows, ddof=1, per episode/edge
risk_estimation.v_D: drift sample variance over all 12 C rows, ddof=1, per episode/edge
risk_estimation.primary_ratio: unweighted mean of all 48 transport cells / unweighted mean of all 48 direct cells
risk_estimation.zero_cells: Retain all cells and episodes; never divide each cell or drop zero cells.
risk_estimation.finite_population_correction: None; plug-in iid-source projection, not an unbiased finite-population guarantee.
risk_estimation.risk_definition: Conditional-graph repeated-sample variance proxy; not squared error against known population credit.
risk_estimation.bank_necessary_count: Count and report v_A/12 < v_B/5 across all 48 cells; zero=zero fails strict inequality.

cost_estimation.exact_label: 初始化+反馈的实测token成本
cost_estimation.I_bank_episode: sum observed 12 I cold-A-menu token counts
cost_estimation.A_single_question: cold A base logical tokens + six A toggle incremental tokens
cost_estimation.B_single_question: cold B base logical tokens + six B toggle incremental tokens, never cached B16-call surrogate
cost_estimation.AB_single_question: observed A/B union executed tokens, 37 unique calls per C question for fixed graph template
cost_estimation.transport_new_episode: 3 * mean all12 C AB union tokens
cost_estimation.incremental_ratio: Same products using only transport_new/direct_new; descriptive, not primary
cost_estimation.cold_direct_reference: Report direct new token costs without I bank separately; no equivalent-initialization claim
cost_estimation.future_service_sensitivity: Add the common prospective S24 cap 1800192 to both acquisition totals only as upper-cap sensitivity, not actual service cost.
cost_estimation.from_scratch_coefficient: mean cells (sqrt(v_A*c_A)+sqrt(v_D*c_D))^2 / mean cells(v_B*c_B); c are episode mean per-question token costs; continuous allocation envelope, not implemented policy
cost_estimation.latency_claim: No cold-B GPU latency claim from cached outputs; no token-to-GPU conversion assumption.
cost_estimation.actual_policy_expenditure: May differ; common conservative cap is not equal actual expenditure.

decision_estimation.per_fold: Build all method actions from I and fixed training rows before querying heldout quality.
decision_estimation.heldout: All 6 B-quality rows of the other fold; same rows across all methods.
decision_estimation.episode_metric: Mean of two fold accuracy means; all 12 C questions each validated once.
decision_estimation.population_metric: Unweighted mean over all 8 episode metrics.
decision_estimation.independence: Folds share I bank; episodes have graph symmetries; this is exploratory R1 development reuse, not new confirmation.
decision_estimation.beta_fit: One global scalar per heldout episode, estimated from the other 7 episodes only. Average ddof=1 C_A sample variances and C_A/C_B sample covariances over their 42 episode-edge cells (center within each episode and edge); beta=cov/[variance*(1+3/12)].
decision_estimation.beta_degenerate: If mean source variance <=1e-12 set beta=0 and flag degeneration; this secondary baseline cannot rescue primary gates.
decision_estimation.deployment_beta_proposal: Same formula fitted once to all 8 R1 episodes for a later independent pilot; report but never substitute for primary beta1.
decision_estimation.decision_uncertainty: No confirmatory interval; report all 8 episode contrasts and two folds, no winner search.

bootstrap.exact_order: For each replicate sequentially draw episode indices size8, then I-row indices shape(8,12), then C-row indices shape(8,12). Each selected episode occurrence gets independent row draws; C A/B use the same row indices.
bootstrap.recomputed: ddof=1 v_A, v_B, v_D and ratio of their all-cell means
bootstrap.undefined_denominator: Any replicate with mean(v_B/5)<=1e-4 is invalid, including near-zero, zero, nonpositive or nonfinite denominators. Record count/fraction; do not drop or regularize.
bootstrap.invalid_effect: Any invalid replicate makes primary interval null and G2 INCONCLUSIVE, even if finite replicates look favorable.
bootstrap.scope: Eight-cluster, small-question exploratory investment screen; no coverage or Type-I-error guarantee.

G0.pass: Exact allowlisted complete arrays, immutable receipts/hash bindings, question disjointness, fixed seeds, matching metadata and cost provenance; no S inputs.

G2.clear_no_go_definition: Valid 90% interval lower bound >=1.0; otherwise failed G2 is INCONCLUSIVE_CURRENT_BANK_AND_QUOTA.
G2.pass: All listed inequalities and valid denominators hold.

G3.clear_no_go_definition: Negative mean transport-direct or transport-old; descriptive practical rejection, not a significance test.

G4.owner: root automatic resource and throughput audit, no new user approval needed
G4.pass: New complete pilot fits pre-reserved16GPUh or prefrozen<=32GPUh and remaining global160GPUh/5round budget; no outcome-based extension.

gates.final_gpu_go: Only root can record GO_NEW_INDEPENDENT_DEVELOPMENT_PILOT after G0-G4 pass.
gates.candidate_failure: Retain this route and diagnostics; continue a distinct authorized candidate within global limits, without automatically ending project.

fixed_secondary.m24_m48: Algebraic extrapolation using observed I variance; no new bank observed and no gate substitution.
fixed_secondary.no_change: Replace B-quality by the very same A-quality array, so drift exactly zero by construction. Verify beta1=old bank and separately evaluate pooled independent old+new3 mean on heldout A. Do not call copied A an independent new world.

formal_pilot.new_pilot_primary: A->B future accuracy: beta1 transport minus direct under complete shared caps; source/CV controls retained.
formal_pilot.progress: Freeze a new independently powered confirmation only after valid prospective development evidence; neither R1 nor R2 final/sealed test is used for tuning.

scientific_claim_boundary: No new estimator theory; no claim of system improvement without fresh service and full measured costs. Diagnostic success is only permission to spend a bounded research budget.
